snippet.title: Undertale: Disbelief (Phase 2 Release) - Trailer
snippet.description:
You've waited two years for this release! Phase 2 is finally out, ready for everyone to play. You can download the latest demo here:
https://gamejolt.com/games/disbelief/268091

Progress has been going slow due to lack of developers, but we are still constantly working on the game. For more information, you can read this post I wrote on GameJolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/disbelief/268091/devlog/the-team-is-still-hard-at-work-some-clarifications-about-our-rad-ryiw93ta

Long story short, shortly after the release of our demo 1.0.1, we changed engine from Clickteam Fusion to GameMaker Studio, which means we had to start from scratch. We did this to make some of our planned features play out better than they could have, using Fusion.

If you're gonna upload videos on our game (which we hope you will), please use #disbeliefgame so we can watch them!

Song used in this trailer:
https://soundcloud.com/flamesatgames/undertale-disbelief-phase-2
